subject: Lake Cave
text: Lake Cave is west of Cannock's Walls on an island reached by a double bridge.

evidence.quote: the Lake Cave is 'west of Cannock's Walls'.
situated on an island with a double-bridge leading to it.

subject: Lake Cave south room
text: The south room at the Lake Cave entrance holds a chest with a Medical Herb.

evidence.quote: In the south room you will find a treasure chest containing a MEDICAL HERB.

subject: Lake Cave east room
text: The east room of the Lake Cave fork holds a chest with 19 gold.

evidence.quote: In the east room there is a chest that contains 19 GOLD.

subject: Lake Cave
text: Continuing west through a couple of doors leads to a stairway down to B2 in the Lake Cave.

evidence.quote: Continue the path through a couple of doors and you will find a stairway leading down to B2.

subject: Lake Cave B2 east chest
text: The second branch on Lake Cave B2 leads right to a chest with a Medical Herb.

evidence.quote: The next one down leads right to a room with a chest that contains a MEDICAL HERB.

subject: Lake Cave B2 west chest
text: On Lake Cave B2, the first of the last two branches leads left to an Antidote Herb.

evidence.quote: First go left to pick up an ANTIDOTE HERB.

subject: Lake Cave B2 final branch chests
text: The final branch on Lake Cave B2 leads left to a room with two chests holding a Wing of Wyvern and 33 gold.

evidence.quote: The final branch leads left to a room with 2 treasure chests... grab them to get a WING OF WYVERN and 33 GOLD.

subject: Silver Key
text: The last treasure chest on Lake Cave B2, reached through rooms to the south, contains the Silver Key.

evidence.quote: The path will pass through a few rooms and you will come to the last treasure chest.
Open it to find... the SILVER KEY!

subject: Chain Sickle
text: Around level 5 the hero should have enough gold to buy a Chain Sickle for both the prince and themselves.

evidence.quote: By the time you get the prince up to level 5, you should have...enough GOLD to buy both the prince and yourself a Chain Sickle.

subject: Chain Mail
text: Two sets of Chain Mail can be bought after returning from the Lake Cave with the Silver Key.

evidence.quote: Now the only thing you need to buy is 2 sets of Chain Mail, but that can wait until we get back...from the Lake Cave with the Silver Key.

subject: Chain Mail
text: The gold for two suits of Chain Mail must be earned by fighting enemies at the Lake Cave before leaving the area.

evidence.quote: You should go back to the Lake Cave and fight some enemies to gain enough GOLD to purchase those two suits of Chain Mail...before you leave for the next part of the world.

subject: Hero
text: At this point the hero is expected to be around level 8 and the prince around level 6 or 7.

evidence.quote: By now you are probably at level 8 and the prince is probably at...level 6 or 7.

subject: Monolith south of Cannock route
requires: Have a companion in the party
text: The monolith south of the route leads into a mainland tunnel that is usable only with a companion.

evidence.quote: This is a passageway to the 'mainland' and you are only allowed to take it if you have a companion with you.

subject: Mainland tunnel
text: In the tunnel, going straight down from the stairs is the correct route; the wrong way leads to an island in the river.

evidence.quote: To get through the tunnel, just go straight down from the stairs -- not too hard, right?
If you go the wrong way you will find yourself on an...island in the middle of the river that separates the island of Midenhall

subject: Mainland exit
text: After the tunnel, a lengthy walk south leads to the town of Hamlin.

evidence.quote: and after quite a lengthy walk you will...come upon the town of Hamlin.

subject: Hamlin Lottery
text: Hamlin has a Lottery where you can win items if you have a Lottery Ticket.

evidence.quote: This town also features a Lottery -- a game where you can win items (if you're lucky).
To play, you must have a Lottery Ticket.

subject: Lottery Ticket
text: Lottery Tickets can be found after battle or in a chest, or given by the tool shop merchant as a side bonus.

evidence.quote: There are two ways to get Lottery Tickets -- you may find them after battle (or in a chest)...merchant will give you one as a 'side bonus'.

subject: Hamlin Lottery
text: Lottery prize #1 for 3 Sun symbols is the Golden Card.

evidence.quote: PRIZE #1 = 3 SUN SYMBOLS = GOLDEN CARD

subject: Hamlin Lottery
text: Lottery prize #2 for 3 Star symbols is the Wizard's Ring.

evidence.quote: PRIZE #2 = 3 STAR SYMBOLS = WIZARD'S RING

subject: Hamlin Lottery
text: Lottery prize #3 for 3 Moon symbols is the Wizard's Wand.

evidence.quote: PRIZE #3 = 3 MOON SYMBOLS = WIZARD'S WAND

subject: Hamlin Lottery
text: Lottery prize #4 for 3 Water symbols is the Dragon's Bane.

evidence.quote: PRIZE #4 = 3 WATER SYMBOLS = DRAGON'S BANE

subject: Hamlin Lottery
text: Lottery prize #5 for 3 Heart symbols is a Medical Herb.

evidence.quote: PRIZE #5 = 3 HEART SYMBOLS = MEDICAL HERB

evidence.quote: TOOL SHOP --------- MEDICAL HERB 15 G ANTIDOTE 8 G WING OF WYVERN 80 G FAIRY WATER 40 G

evidence.quote: WING OF WYVERN     80 G

subject: Fairy Water
text: Fairy Water costs 40 gold at the Hamlin tool shop.

evidence.quote: FAIRY WATER        40 G

subject: Chain Sickle
text: A Chain Sickle costs 390 gold at the Hamlin weapon shop.

evidence.quote: CHAIN SICKLE       390 G

subject: Iron Spear

subject: Broad Sword
text: A Broad Sword costs 1500 gold at the Hamlin weapon shop.

evidence.quote: BROAD SWORD        1500 G

subject: Chain Mail

evidence.quote: CHAIN MAIL         480 G

evidence.quote: FULL PLATE ARMOR   1000 G

subject: Steel Shield

subject: Dog in Hamlin
text: A dog in Hamlin follows the hero when talked to, and its location must be remembered for later.

evidence.quote: Walking around town, you will also probably notice a dog that follows you around when you talk to it.
cute doggie into your memory because you will need to come back here...later.

subject: Hamlin
text: From Hamlin, head east, walk north along the river to a bridge, cross it and head south along the coast past Baboons, then cross bridges and take the grassy path west to reach the tower.

evidence.quote: From the town of Hamlin, head east.  Don't cross the bridge; instead, walk north along the river...across another bridge.  Cross it and head south...Follow the winding path that leads along the coastline, making sure to watch out for BABOONs along the way -- they're pretty tough...walking, you will come back out in the forest...Take the first bridge you come to, then take another bridge south...Take the next two bridges take the grassy path that leads west...Before long, you will come across the tower (finally!).

subject: Iron Spear
text: Before the tower, chop up monsters for gold to buy an Iron Spear for the Prince and Full Plate Armor for the hero.

evidence.quote: head out and chop up monsters for a while and buy an Iron Spear for the Prince and some Full Plate Armor for yourself.

subject: Hero
text: By the time the Iron Spear and Full Plate Armor are bought, the hero is likely at least level 11.

evidence.quote: Well by the time you get those two pieces of equipment, it is likely that you will be at least level 11.

subject: Cloak of Wind tower floor 1
text: Floor 1 of the tower has three stairways leading up.

evidence.quote: There are three stairways leading up on the first floor.

subject: Tower floor 1 chest
text: A chest in the room to the right, south of the first intersection, contains a Medical Herb.

evidence.quote: First walk to the intersection where the first stairway is, and continue south and into the room on the right.
There is a chest there that contains a MEDICAL...HERB.

subject: Floor 1 first-intersection stairway
text: The stairway at the first intersection and the southwest stairway are connected and lead up 7 floors to a dead end.

evidence.quote: The stairway in the first intersection and the stairway to the southwest are connected, and lead all the way up 7 floors to a dead end.

subject: Floor 1 northeast corner stairs
text: Take the stairs in the northeast corner of the first floor instead of the dead-end stairs.

evidence.quote: Instead, take the stairs in the northeast corner of the first floor.

subject: Cloak of Wind tower edges
text: Walking off the edge of the tower drops you all the way back down outside the tower.

evidence.quote: A man there warns you not to walk off the edge of the tower.
If you do, you will fall all the way back down outside the tower.

subject: Cloak of Wind tower floor 6
text: Walking off the edge on floor 6 right before the treasure is annoying because it drops you outside the tower.

evidence.quote: it is very annoying if you accidentally walk off on the sixth floor right before you get the treasure you are looking for.

subject: Floor 2 northwest corner stairs
text: Follow the path left to the stairs in the northwest corner of floor 2.

evidence.quote: Follow the path left and take the stairs in the northwest corner of floor 2.

subject: Tower floor 2 chest
text: A chest along the way down from floor 2 holds 48 gold.

evidence.quote: Then head down, stopping to pick up the 48 GOLD that is in the chest along the way.

subject: Floor 3 southwest corner stairs
text: In the southwest corner of floor 3, stairs lead up.

evidence.quote: In the southwest corner of floor 3, there are...more stairs leading up.

subject: Floor 4 southern path stairs
text: On floor 4, head east to the stairs in the middle of the southern path, then follow the path up through floor 5 and back down to floor 2 to find the Cloak of Wind.

evidence.quote: On Floor 4, head east and you will find a set...of stairs in the middle of the southern path...Take them and follow the path up through floor 5 and back down to 2 where you will find the Cloak of Wind!

subject: Cloak of Wind
text: The Cloak of Wind is found on floor 2 of the tower, reached by going up to floor 5 and back down.

evidence.quote: Take them and follow the path up through floor 5 and back down to 2 where you will find the Cloak of Wind!

subject: Tower floor 9 chest
text: The treasure chest on floor 9 of the tower is empty and only worth climbing to for EXP or gold.

evidence.quote: Way up top on the 9th...floor is a treasure chest, but it is empty.
you are healthy and need the EXP/GOLD.

subject: Cloak of Wind tower
text: Walk off the tower edge and cast the Return spell to return to the entrance of Hamlin.

evidence.quote: When you are done, walk off the edge of the tower and cast the spell of RETURN.
yourself back at the entrance to the town of Hamlin.

subject: Cloak of Wind
text: The Cloak of Wind is equipped by using it from the ITEM menu, like a medical herb.

evidence.quote: into the ITEM menu and USE it, just like you would a medical herb or
You will put on the Cloak of Wind.

subject: Mirror of Ra
location: Small swamp south and east of Moonbrooke
text: The Mirror of Ra is found by searching the northeast corner of the small swamp south and east of Moonbrooke.

evidence.quote: Instead head south and east, back in the direction where the tower was.
As you walk you should come across a small section of swamp.
Walk to the northeast corner of the swamp (ugh) and SEARCH.
There, you will find the Mirror of Ra!

subject: Mirror of Ra
text: Using the Mirror of Ra on the dog in Hamlin shatters it and transforms the dog into the Princess of Moonbrooke.

evidence.quote: Go back into town and find our canine friend, and use the Mirror of Ra.
The mirror shatters, and the dog magically transforms into the Princess of...Moonbrooke!

subject: Princess of Moonbrooke
text: The Princess of Moonbrooke is freed from the dog form and is able to join the party.

evidence.quote: Now that the spell placed on her has been broken, she is free to join your party.

subject: Princess of Moonbrooke
text: The princess starts at level 1, so the hero should fight nearby to let her gain a few levels.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, the princess also starts out on level 1, so you may...want to fight around for a little while and let her gain a few levels.

subject: Princess of Moonbrooke
text: Leave the area once the princess is around level 4 or 5 and the hero has the necessary equipment.

evidence.quote: Once you have all the necessary equipment, and the princess is at...level 4 or 5, then we can head outta here and get on with the adventure!

subject: Broad Sword
text: Buy a Broad Sword and a Steel Shield for the hero before leaving this area.

evidence.quote: You should also buy a BROAD SWORD and a STEEL SHIELD for the hero before...you leave this area.

subject: Flame ghosts of Moonbrooke Castle
text: The flame-like figures walking the ruined castle are ghosts of former residents who speak when talked to.

evidence.quote: There are 'flames' walking around the castle.
Upon talking to them, you will find that they are the ghosts of the people who used to...be at the castle.

subject: Ghost of the King
text: The ghost of the King is in the throne room of Moonbrooke Castle.

evidence.quote: You will also find the ghost of the King in the throne room.

subject: Moonbrooke Castle chests
text: Both treasure chests in the ruined Castle of Moonbrooke are empty.

evidence.quote: There are two treasure chests in the castle, but they are...both empty.

subject: Last living person in Moonbrooke Castle
object: room at bottom of castle outer edge
text: The only person left alive in the castle is found by entering the room to the right near the bottom and taking the stairs down.

evidence.quote: Near the bottom, enter the room again to the right and take the stairs leading...down.  This guy is the only person left alive in the entire castle.

subject: Castle of Moonbrooke swamp
text: The swamp areas inside Castle of Moonbrooke deal damage, so watch where you step.

evidence.quote: There are damage zones (swamp) all over the place so watch where you step.

subject: Castle of Moonbrooke
text: From the castle head west, enter the monolith by the bridge south, use the other stairs across the river, then go north and west through a desert to the Dragon's Horn tower.

evidence.quote: Exit this wasteland of a castle and continue to the west...Take the bridge south and entire the monolith...Take the other stairs and you will be on the other side of the river...Continue to the north and west, through a huge desert...After walking for what seems like forever, you will come across the Dragon's Horn tower.

subject: Dragon's Horn tower
text: Be at least level 13 before entering the Dragon's Horn tower.

evidence.quote: I recommend that you be at least level 13 before entering...the tower.

subject: Dragon's Horn tower
text: Climb upward in the Dragon's Horn tower while avoiding the big pit that drops back to the first floor.

evidence.quote: making sure that you don't fall into the big pit that leads all the way back down to the first floor.

subject: Dragon's Horn tower floor 6
text: On floor 6, jumping off the north edge of the tower lands you on the north side of the river.

evidence.quote: When you reach floor 6, jump off the north edge of the tower, and voila!
You will find yourself on the north side of the river.

subject: Cloak of Wind
text: With the Cloak of Wind you can jump from the south tower over to the north side of the Dragon's Horn.

evidence.quote: with the Cloak of Wind, you can jump from the south tower over to the north side.

subject: North side of river
text: From the north side of the river, head north and east to the town of Lianport.

evidence.quote: Now that you're back on good old ground again, head north and east
to the town of Lianport.

subject: Dragon's Bane
text: The Dragon's Bane is a new item sold in the Lianport tool shop.

evidence.quote: In the tool shop, you'll find a new item -- the Dragon's Bane.

subject: Dragon's Bane
text: Equipping the Dragon's Bane slightly increases defense, similar to the Dragon Scale in Dragon Warrior I.

evidence.quote: This item is very similar to the Dragon Scale in Dragon Warrior I.
you put this on, your defense will increase slightly.

subject: Wizard's Wand
text: The Wizard's Wand is sold at the Lianport weapon shop for 2500 gold and is a must-buy for the Princess.

evidence.quote: You will also find some equipment for the Princess here -- the...Wizard's Wand and the Clothes Hiding are both a must.
cough up 2500 G for it, but don't count on winning it easily.

subject: Clothes Hiding
text: Clothes Hiding is a must-buy equipment for the Princess at the Lianport weapon shop.

evidence.quote: You will also find some equipment for the Princess here -- the...Wizard's Wand and the Clothes Hiding are both a must.

subject: Wizard's Wand
text: The Wizard's Wand can also be won in the lottery, though winning it is unlikely.

evidence.quote: you can win the Wizard's Wand in the lottery without having to
cough up 2500 G for it, but don't count on winning it easily.

subject: Two Gremlins
object: area where a girl is surrounded by demon-like creatures
text: Two Gremlins charge and attack when you enter the area where a girl is surrounded by demons; be fully healed first.

evidence.quote: When you enter the area, two GREMLINs charge and attack you.
You will want to make sure that you are fully healed before...entering the fight, because these guys are rather tough.

subject: Girl in Lianport
text: After the two Gremlins are defeated, the girl thanks the hero and asks them to follow her to meet her grandfather.

evidence.quote: When you take care of those two pesky fiends, the girl will...graciously thank you and ask you to follow her to meet her grandfather.

subject: Girl's grandfather
text: The girl's grandfather gives the hero his ship.

evidence.quote: He will also thank you graciously and give you a fine present -- his ship!

subject: Ship
text: Going down on the ship and opening the locked door with the Silver Key reveals a merchant.

evidence.quote: When you board the ship, go down and open that locked door with the Silver Key.
Inside is a merchant who tells you of a pirate ship,

subject: Relentless pirate treasure
text: The merchant offers a handsome reward if the hero finds the treasure of the pirate ship Relentless, which sank near Lianport.

evidence.quote: named Relentless, that sank near Lianport.
There was a great treasure aboard that ship, and he offers you a handsome reward if you can find...that treasure for him!

subject: Relentless treasure
object: Patch of white water northeast of Lianport
text: The sunken Relentless treasure is found by searching the white water patch northeast of Lianport from the ship.

evidence.quote: You should see a patch of water that is white instead of blue.
Look around, it is not far to the northeast of the town of Lianport.
position the ship so that the patch of water is directly above you.

subject: Lianport merchant
text: Taking the recovered treasures back to the Lianport merchant earns the Echoing Flute.

evidence.quote: Take the treasures back to the merchant in Lianport and he will
give you a valuable item in return.  This item is the ECHOING FLUTE.

subject: Echoing Flute
text: Blowing the Echoing Flute in an area with a crest makes the flute echo, helping find the five crests.

evidence.quote: This item can be useful in finding the five crests that are scattered throughout the world.
is a crest, the flute will echo.

subject: Monolith northwest of Lianport
text: The monolith northwest of Lianport has a locked door inside that requires the Golden Key.

evidence.quote: FYI, there is a monolith to the northwest of Lianport.
Unfortunately, there is a locked door inside that requires the Golden...Key to open.

subject: Lianport
text: From Lianport, follow the coastline north to its northern edge, head northwest to a very small island with a town and an even smaller monolith island, then enter Zahan.

evidence.quote: Follow the coastline back to the northern edge of the island and head to the northwest.
You should come across a very small island with a town on it and a monolith on an...island that's even smaller.
Anyway, for now, enter the town of Zahan.

subject: Monolith in middle of nowhere
text: This monolith is where the hero is thrown when entering the travel door in Midenhall Castle.

evidence.quote: Yeah, this is that 'monolith in the middle of nowhere' that you were thrown to when you entered the travel door back in Midenhall Castle.
